_conventions._doc: Hand-authored truth for the HighNotes harness scorer (score.py). Keyed by fixture image FILENAME (cannabis labels have no folder-slug ground truth like wine appellations, so each must be read off the label by a human once). Assert ONLY fields you can confidently read off the label; OMIT anything absent/illegible — omitted/null fields are NOT scored. ProductType values: flower | vape | edible | concentrate | preRoll | tincture | topical | other.
_conventions.string_fields: strainName/cultivator: case-insensitive, whitespace-folded; pass if the truth is contained in the model value (handles trailing brand/weight noise)
_conventions.numeric_cannabinoids_pct: totalThc/totalCbd/thca/delta9thc/cbd/cbg/totalCannabinoids — percent as printed; scored within +/-0.5 absolute (labels round; OCR drops a digit)
_conventions.weight_dates: netWeight scored by digits+unit; harvestDate/expirationDate scored as ISO YYYY-MM-DD exact
_conventions.dominantTerpene: TRUTH-ONLY convenience field — the single highest-% terpene on the label. NOT a CannabisLabel field; scored against whichever terpene the model reports highest.
_conventions.omitted_or_null: field not present on the label OR not confidently read -> leave it out -> not scored
_conventions._firstpass_note: IMG_* entries filled first-pass by Claude vision off the photos (not the app). VERIFY before trusting, especially terpene %s and the blurry pre-roll (IMG_0783). 'pinene' omitted throughout because labels print Alpha+Beta pinene separately and the single field is ambiguous. Edibles are mg-dosed, so their cannabinoid %s are omitted (don't map to the %% fields). Several files are rotations/dupes of the same product.
